verdict.rationale: Stripe provides a general MCP server (docs-35, probe-4) letting AI agents call the Stripe API, which could technically include Terminal endpoints, but there is no Terminal-specific evidence of natural-language control of POS/reader operations (registering readers, collecting payments, tipping, etc.). Missing for 10: Terminal-specific NL command examples, agent-driven reader/payment workflows, and independent confirmation that MCP tools cover Terminal endpoints.
